Six real websites I designed and built. Switch tabs like a browser, then open the live site.

🔒 verasustainables.comOpen live ↗

Sustainable packaging · New Delhi

Vera

A B2B site for a bamboo-biopolymer packaging startup, built to convince FMCG procurement teams that a new material is ready for production.

  • Three product lines, each with its own page: rigid, flexible and returnable packaging.
  • Client, backer and certification logo walls (FDA, CIPET, RoHS) for instant trust.
  • A category grid showing where the material fits across eight FMCG categories.
  • A requirements form that captures company, category and quantity.
StrategyUI designDevelopmentLead capture
🔒 skyabroad.coOpen live ↗

Recruitment platform · Europe

Sky Abroad

A recruitment platform built for Europe. Employers and candidates work in one place that tracks every stage of a hire, from screening and credential checks to permits, arrival and probation.

  • A live hiring workspace showing verified talent and each candidate’s recognition progress.
  • The full path explained: screening, credential recognition, placement and relocation.
  • English and German versions, with light and dark modes.
  • A sister brand to EuropaWork: related, but clearly distinct.
Product designDevelopmentCopy structure
🔒 hire.skyabroad.coOpen live ↗

Global hiring platform · Partner portal

Sky Abroad Hire

A global hiring platform and a gateway to a verified, qualified and skilled workforce, where partners browse candidates and run their hiring in one place.

  • Three talent streams: healthcare, IT and blue-collar professionals.
  • Partners browse verified candidates, manage their pipeline and share shortlists.
  • GDPR and ISO 27001 hosting shown up front, so employers trust it with candidate data.
  • Nine European markets shown at a glance.
Product designWeb appDevelopmentPartner portal
🔒 europawork.inOpen live ↗

Offshore recruitment · 6 markets

EuropaWork

A trust-first site for an offshore recruitment firm serving agencies and employers in the UK, US, Australia, Ireland and the Netherlands, plus a nursing pathway to Germany.

  • Separate pathways for agencies, employers and nurses, so visitors self-select in one click.
  • Candidate login and portal, apply flow and eligibility checker.
  • A six-step engagement process, six country pages and an FAQ.
  • An anti-fraud notice and data-compliance statements that reassure everyone.
Information architectureUI designDevelopmentCandidate portal
🔒 himtattvahartola.inOpen live ↗

Boutique homestay · Uttarakhand

Himtattva

A cinematic site for a Himalayan homestay at 7,000 ft. The brief: make people feel the mountain air before they book.

  • A ‘take a deep breath’ preloader with ambient flute audio and a hero video.
  • A live weather and air-quality widget for Hartola.
  • A guest pre-arrival check-in page and a corporate-retreat page.
  • An illustrated attractions map, gallery and eight local-ethos stories.
Brand experienceMotionDevelopmentBooking flow
🔒 helixcapital.co.inOpen live ↗

Fundraising & advisory · New Delhi

Helix Capital

A site for a fundraising and advisory firm working with seed and pre-Series A startups, built to talk to founders and investors on the same page without blurring either one.

  • Two front doors, ‘I’m a startup’ and ‘I’m an investor’, so visitors self-select in one tap.
  • The two-stage model, get ready then get connected, laid out as numbered steps.
  • Five published selection criteria, so founders can qualify themselves before they write in.
  • A track-record logo wall, plain-English fees and a clear disclaimer.
PositioningUI designDevelopmentLead capture

What I bring

10 yrs

working with global companies, including Amazon India. I’ve seen from the inside what makes a website work, and I bring that to growing businesses.

What ten years taught me a website needs

The right sectionsWhich sections a business site needs and in what order, so visitors find what they came for.
Photos that earn trustWhich photos make a business look real and established, and where they belong on the page.
Infographics that explainNumbers, processes and product details turned into visuals people understand in seconds.
One clear next stepEvery page leads somewhere: enquire, book or apply. No dead ends.

What do you need made?

A new website, a better version of the one you have, or the decks and infographics you use to sell your services. I do all three.

Build a new website

For businesses that need a site from the ground up.

  • Company websites and landing pages
  • Booking, enquiry and application flows
  • Client and candidate portals, hiring platforms
  • Sections, photos and infographics planned from day one
Start a new site

Improve the one you have

For businesses whose website no longer does them justice.

  • Redesign pages that look dated
  • Add or rework sections, photos and infographics
  • Add features: forms, booking, portals
  • Fix slow or broken pages
Improve my site

Decks, presentations & infographics

For businesses that need to explain and sell their services well.

  • Business decks that pitch your services
  • Company and sales presentations
  • Infographics for your services, process and numbers
  • Designed in your brand, ready to send, print or present
Get a deck made

Big-company rigour, founder speed.

At a global company, every pixel and every second of load time either earns trust or loses it. I learned that over ten years working with global companies, including Amazon India. The sites above serve a packaging startup, two international recruiters, a global hiring platform and a Himalayan homestay. Different worlds, same goal: a website that does real work for the business.

About me

I’m Manjeet Singh, a founder who designs and builds websites, business decks and infographics. For 10 years I worked with global companies, including Amazon India, and saw up close what a website needs: the right sections, the right photos and infographics, and a clear next step. That’s why I’m a good fit for growing businesses, whether you need a new website, changes to the one you have, or a deck that sells your services.
